findings.text: Only 2 of 3 passes could be measured (1 blocked). Figures are medians of the passes that worked.
During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 5 requests to 3 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 2.2 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 491 kB (22%) came from third-party domains, 291 kB of it from services classified as tracking (4 requests).

2 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: adsafeprotected.com (Integral Ad Science, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising).
